description_en: Modifies a cloud editing project. You can modify the title, timeline, and cover image of the project
description_zh: 修改云剪辑工程，支持修改标题、时间线和封面等
name: UpdateEditingProject

parameters.help_en: The title of the cloud editing project
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The description of the cloud editing project
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The timeline of the cloud editing project in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 云剪辑工程时间线，Json格式
parameters.name: timeline

parameters.help_en: The template ID, which is used to quickly build a timeline with minimal effort.><notice>Exactly one of ProjectId, Timeline, and TemplateId must be specified. If TemplateId is specified, ClipsParam must also be specified.></notice>
parameters.help_zh: 模板Id，用于快速低门槛的构建时间线。><notice>ProjectId、Timeline、TemplateId有且只有一个非空。当TemplateId不为空时，ClipsParam不能为空。></notice>
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The material parameters for the template in JSON format. If TemplateId is specified, ClipsParam must also be specified.<props="china">For more information about the format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328557.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/291418.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 模板对应的素材参数，Json格式，当TemplateId不为空时，ClipsParam不能为空。<props="china">具体格式见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328557.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/291418.html。</props>
parameters.name: clips_param

parameters.help_en: The cover URL of the cloud editing project
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud editing project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The business status of the project. This parameter can be ignored for general editing projects. You can modify the reservation status of the project. Valid values:

Reserving: The project is being reserved.
ReservationCanceled: The reservation is canceled
parameters.help_zh:
工程业务状态，一般剪辑工程可忽略。支持修改工程的预约状态：

Reserving: 预约中
ReservationCanceled: 预约取消
parameters.name: business_status
